title: Italian-Style Moroccan Pork Belly
description: A flavorful and tender pork belly dish infused with the aromas of Italian and Moroccan cuisine. Perfect for a special occasion or a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: Pork belly
ingredients.notes: Ask the butcher for a piece with a good layer of fat

ingredients.name: Msemen
ingredients.notes: Use the Moroccan flatbread for a crispy texture

ingredients.name: Pungent garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic for a stronger flavor

instructions: Season the pork belly with salt, black pepper, and Moroccan cumin.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the pork belly until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork belly to the oven and roast for 20 minutes.
While the pork belly is cooking, warm the msemen sheets in the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove the pork belly from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the pork belly into thick strips and serve with the msemen sheets.
